programs.title: The Art Beat II Ep.7
programs.desc: Chinese art is vast, ancient, and profound. This film presents eight leading artists, each drawing from tradition while forging new paths of their own. From classical painting and ballet to literature and storytelling, they harvest from the past, transforming ancient arts into new mediums.

programs.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programs.desc: In this episode, host Kleber travels to Foshan in southern China’s Guangdong Province, to explore the culture of Wing Chun kung fu. There he’ll meet two Wing Chun masters: Guo Weizhan, his first instructor in China, and Xian Zhiming, an expert in the unique principles of Snake-Style Wing Chun.

programs.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programs.desc: In 2022, a video game inspired by Pak Mei kung fu became an online sensation. Continuing his exploration of Foshan, host Kleber meets with a true master of Pak Mei to learn more of the history of martial arts, as well as its connections to food, family and community.

programs.title: Wan-go Weng: The Moon Like a Blade
programs.desc: With a modern take on archival footage, rediscover the forgotten scholar and art connoisseur Wan-go Weng, whose lifelong patriotism is reflected in his dedication to preserving cultural heritage.
